name: Split Napa Baby Romaine Caesar Salad with Parmigiano-Reggiano (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Aged Parmigiano-Reggiano and croutons are fine, but raw romaine ribs and lemon-garlic Caesar dressing carry flare risk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip raw Caesar salads during flares or eat only the tender inner lettuce tips and aged Parmesan.
watchOuts: Lemon juice and raw garlic in Caesar dressing
